# ferentin_endpoint_agent_approval (Resource)

Endpoint AI-agent decision — whether a catalogued AI agent (`claude-code`, `codex-cli`, `openclaw`, …) may run on managed devices: `report_only` approves it (it runs and its presence is reported), `block` denies it.

An agent with no decision falls through to `unapproved_agent_action` on the device's `ferentin_endpoint_policy_settings` posture (`report_only` unless set).

~> **Destroying a decision is not neutral.** The agent falls back to `unapproved_agent_action`, so under a `block` default, destroying a `report_only` decision **denies** the agent. `plan` warns when it would.

A decision with no `device_group_ids` reaches every device and, like other endpoint policy changes, is staged until an operator activates it in the admin console. A decision scoped to device groups reaches those groups on their next policy poll.

The decision is keyed by `catalog_slug`. Creating one for a slug that already has a decision (for example one made in the console) fails and says to import it instead, rather than overwriting it.

## Import

```
terraform import ferentin_endpoint_agent_approval.example <tenant_id>/<catalog_slug>
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# AI-agent decisions: which catalogued agents may run on managed devices.
# An agent with no decision falls through to unapproved_agent_action on the
# device's posture.

resource "ferentin_device_group" "contractors" {
  name   = "contractors"
  source = "manual"
}

# Approve Claude Code on every device. `report_only` approves: the agent runs
# and its presence is reported.
resource "ferentin_endpoint_agent_approval" "claude_code" {
  catalog_slug = "claude-code"
  action       = "report_only"
  description  = "Sanctioned coding agent"
}

# Deny OpenClaw for contractors only. Devices outside the group fall through
# to unapproved_agent_action, so this needs no second decision for everyone
# else.
resource "ferentin_endpoint_agent_approval" "openclaw_contractors" {
  catalog_slug     = "openclaw"
  action           = "block"
  device_group_ids = [ferentin_device_group.contractors.group_id]
  description      = "Denied pending security review"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `report_only` approves the agent: it runs and its presence is reported. `block` denies it.
- `catalog_slug` (String) The agent's slug in the platform's AI-agent detection catalog, e.g. `claude-code`, `codex-cli`, `openclaw`. The platform refuses a slug that is not a detection-enabled catalog entry. Changing it replaces the decision.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Admin note. Never reaches the device. At most 500 characters.
- `device_group_ids` (List of String) Device groups the decision applies to — reference `ferentin_device_group.<name>.group_id`. Empty or unset = **every device in the tenant**. Devices outside the groups fall through to `unapproved_agent_action`, so "block for one pilot group, allow everywhere else" needs one decision, not two. At most 64.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `approval_id` (String) Platform row UUID. Informational: the decision is addressed by `catalog_slug`.
- `created_at` (String)
- `deferred_pending_user_principal` (Boolean) True when the decision carries user criteria that devices cannot evaluate yet, which makes it inert on every device. Only a decision written outside this provider can have them.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Provenance of the most recent writer. Divergence from `managed_by` is the drift signal.
- `managed_by` (String) Provenance of the original creator (`iac` for this provider). Immutable after create.
- `managed_by_client_id` (String) OAuth2 `client_id` of the creator.
- `managed_by_module` (String) Module label the creator sent via `X-Ferentin-Managed-By-Module`.
- `scope_unreadable` (Boolean) True when the platform cannot read the stored device-group scope. Such a decision is in force on **no** device, even though it reads as unscoped. The provider plans an update that writes the configured scope back.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `version` (Number) Optimistic-concurrency version, sent as `If-Match` on update and delete so a concurrent console edit is rejected with 412 rather than overwritten.
